failures.question: 每个月的订单量环比增长率是多少？

WITH monthly_orders AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders

  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(
         (order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month))::numeric

failures.question: 各仓库的库存周转情况：当前库存量、近 90 天出库量、库存周转天数分别是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH inv AS (
    SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS current_inventory
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
),
anchor AS (
    SELECT MAX(moved_at) AS max_moved_at
    FROM inventory_movements
),
outbound AS (
    SELECT im.warehouse_id, SUM(im.quantity) AS outbound_qty_90d
    FROM inventory_movements im
    CROSS JOIN anchor a
    WHERE im.movement_type = 2
      AND im.moved_at >= a.max_moved_at - INTERVAL '90 days'
      AND im.moved_at <= a.max_moved_at
    GROUP BY im.warehouse_id
)
SELECT
    w.warehouse_id,
    COALESCE(inv.current_inventory, 0) AS current_inventory,
    COALESCE(outbound.outbound_qty_90d, 0) AS outbound_qty_90d,
    ROUND(90.0 * COALESCE(inv.current_inventory, 0) / NULLIF(outbound.outbound_qty_90d, 0), 1) AS inventory_turnover_days
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN inv ON inv.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN outbound ON outbound.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
ORDER BY w.warehouse_id
LIMIT 1000;

WITH inv AS (
    SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS current_inventory
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
),
anchor AS (
    SELECT MAX(moved_at) AS max_moved_at
    FROM inventory_movements
),
outbound AS (
    SELECT im.warehouse_id, SUM(im.quantity) AS outbound_qty_90d
    FROM inventory_movements im
    CROSS JOIN anchor a
    WHERE im.movement_type = 2
      AND im.moved_at >= a.max_moved_at - INTERVAL '90 days'
      AND im.moved_at <= a.max_moved_at
    GROUP BY im.warehouse_id
)
SELECT
    w.warehouse_id,
    COALESCE(inv.current_inventory, 0) AS current_inventory,
    COALESCE(outbound.outbound_qty_90d, 0) AS outbound_qty_90d,
    ROUND(90.0 * COALESCE(inv.current_inventory, 0) / NULLIF(outbound.outbound_qty_90d, 0), 1) AS inventory_turnover_days
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN inv ON inv.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN outbound ON outbound.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
ORDER BY w.warehouse_id
LIMIT 1000;
